name: Kettle Brand Sea Salt Potato Chips (Thick Cut WARNING)
whyItWorks: Extra thick-cut potato slices kettle-cooked in oil to a hard, rigid crispness. The sharp, jagged chip shards can physically scratch inflamed bowel segments, and the high fat (9g per ounce) triggers rapid gastrocolic dumping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid during active disease. Baked Lay's or plain thin crisps are far safer.
